title: A New Morning: Lin's Sleep and Exercise Plan · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: Lin is a 28-year-old office worker in Chengdu. Last year, she had a bad habit. She went to bed at 1 a. m. because she watched videos on her phone. She felt tired every morning. She drank three cups of coffee a day, so she was very nervous. Coffee made her feel worried and stressed. She did not exercise, so her back hurt. She sat at her desk all day, and this was not good for her body. In March, Lin changed her routine. Now she goes to bed at 11 p. m. because she wants to sleep eight hours. Sleep helps her feel good. She puts her phone in the kitchen, so she cannot watch videos in bed. The kitchen is far from her bed, so she must get up to use her phone. She gets up at 7 a. m. and runs in the park for 20 minutes.
